**Friendlier dialogs.** A mistake no longer closes the dialog and loses what
you typed: Cloak shows what to fix, right there, and puts the cursor on it.

## Downloads

| Platform | File | Needs |
|---|---|---|
| Windows 10/11 (x64) | `cloak-v0.2.4-windows-x64.zip` | [WinFsp](https://winfsp.dev) (`winget install WinFsp.WinFsp`) |
| macOS (Apple Silicon) | `cloak-v0.2.4-macos-arm64.dmg` | [macFUSE](https://macfuse.github.io) |

**Windows:** unzip and run `Cloak\Cloak.exe`. Keep the folder together: the
engine is in `Cloak\bin`, and your drive list and settings are kept in
`Cloak\cloak-data`.

**macOS:** open the disk image and drag **Cloak** onto **Applications**. The
app isn't notarized, so before opening it the first time, clear the download
quarantine: `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Cloak.app` (or
right-click Cloak → Open, then Open again).

## What's new

- **New drive** checks everything before creating anything: a missing name,
  folder or password, passwords that don't match, and a folder that isn't
  empty or is already a drive (with a pointer to Add existing).
- **Add existing** is now a single dialog for the folder and its name (the
  name fills in from the folder), and tells you if the folder isn't a cloak
  drive or is already in your list.
- **Unlock** stays open on a wrong password, a drive letter that's been
  taken, or a mount that fails (for example "WinFsp isn't installed"), so
  you can fix it and try again. It closes once the drive is mounted.

## Known limitations

- **The macOS app has not yet been tested on a real Mac.** Treat it as a
  preview and keep a backup of anything you put in a drive.
- Auto-lock runs on sleep, not when the screen locks.
- The app isn't code-signed, so Windows SmartScreen may warn on first run
  (More info → Run anyway).
- FUSE-T is not supported yet (macFUSE only).
- The middle of every file stays plaintext on disk by design.
